title: Mike Evans, Dre Greenlaw don't practice Wednesday, 49ers hope they can on Thursday

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mike Evans, Dre Greenlaw don't practice Wednesday, 49ers hope they can on Thursday
sources.description: Wide receiver Mike Evans didn't travel with the 49ers for last Sunday's game in Dallas, but he was in Colorado Springs with the team as they prepare for their game against the Vikings in Mexico City.
